summary: Cizzle Brands filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a proposed U.S. listing and U.S. underwritten public offering, alongside a short-form base shelf prospectus supplement. Joseph Gunnar acts as lead underwriter and D. Boral Capital as co-underwriter. Separately, the issuer reached agreements with existing creditors to convert convertible notes into shares and partially repay and extend a vendor take-back note, subject to Offering completion. As an ordinary shelf takedown with balance-sheet adjustments, this is not a special situation; watch for pricing terms, size, and exchange approval.
